card.name: Antiviral nucleoside drug names
card.fires_on: The end of antiviral drug names such as tenofovir, and the start of zidovudine (AZT), in lists of HIV and hepatitis drugs. It also fires on small words next to these names, like 'of' or 'to' before tenofovir or cidofovir.

modes.label: Ending of tenofovir
modes.description: The final piece of tenofovir in drug lists or interaction text.
modes.example: ir, abacavir, emtricitabine, emtricitabine/tenofovir alafenamide, tenofo<<vir>> DF, lamivudine, stav

modes.label: Zidovudine abbreviation
modes.description: The AZ in the (AZT) abbreviation after zidovudine.

modes.label: Linking word before an antiviral
modes.description: Small words such as 'of' or 'to' right before a nucleoside antiviral name.
modes.example: another prodrug<< of>> tenofovir, alone or in
